name: Is it better to repair or replace an old water heater?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair or replace an old water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace an old water heater depends on several factors, including its age, the cost of the repair, and its energy efficiency. If a water heater is more than 10-12 years old, frequently needs repairs, or is inefficient, replacement might be more cost-effective in the long run. Minor issues might warrant a repair. We can assess your specific situation and recommend the best option.
